lead: Virtual Sundays run on Google Classroom and Google Meet. No assembly: test your connection 10:00–10:15, and first period starts at 10:15.

students.title: Sign in with your LearnIslam account
students.body: Use your school Google account, not a personal or parent Gmail. On a personal account, you’ll wait while your teacher checks the roster.

students.title: Open the class for the right period
students.body: Each grade has two classes in Google Classroom, 1st Period and 2nd Period, each with its own Meet link. Go to classroom.google.com or the Classroom app.

students.title: Click Join next to Meet
students.body: It’s at the top left of the class page. If you see a waiting message, stay on that screen until your teacher lets you in.

students.title: Test by 10:15
students.body: There’s no assembly. Test your connection 10:00–10:15. First period starts at 10:15, then the regular schedule.

etiquette: Camera on for the whole class
Mic muted unless it’s your turn
Display name that matches the class roster

teachers.title: Use your LearnIslam account
teachers.body: The admin creates each class and adds you and your students.

teachers.title: Turn on each class’s Meet link (once)
teachers.body: Each grade has a 1st Period and a 2nd Period class, each with its own link. In each class: Settings (gear) → General → Meet link, generate it and make it visible to students.

teachers.title: Remind students Saturday
teachers.body: Post in the Stream: “Virtual class tomorrow! Test your connection 10:00–10:15; class starts 10:15. Join from the Meet link here with your LearnIslam account.”

teachers.title: Open the Meet at 9:50
teachers.body: Start from Classroom and turn on Host controls (shield icon). You can mute everyone, manage joining, and remove anyone disrupting class.

teachers.title: Check names before admitting
teachers.body: Personal accounts show as “asking to join”. Check the name against your roster before admitting, and fix display names you don’t recognize.

teachers.title: Wrap up
teachers.body: Post homework in Classwork, take attendance from People, and choose “End the call for everyone”.

troubleshooting.a: Stay on that screen. Your teacher will let you in after checking the roster. Next time, sign in with your LearnIslam account (profile picture, top right) to get in right away.
Check the signed-in account (profile picture, top right). If it’s your LearnIslam account and the class still isn’t there, email for help.
Each grade has a 1st Period and a 2nd Period class. Join 1st Period at 10:15, then switch to the 2nd Period class after the break.

troubleshooting.q: Our shared computer keeps using the parent’s account
troubleshooting.a: In Chrome, click the profile icon (top right) → Add, and make a profile for the student’s LearnIslam account. Use it for every class.

troubleshooting.q: Joining from a phone or tablet
troubleshooting.a: Install the Classroom and Meet apps, add the LearnIslam account in each (tap the profile picture), and select it.

troubleshooting.q: No sound, or nobody can hear me
troubleshooting.a: Check you’re unmuted, then ⋮ → Settings → Audio and pick the right microphone and speaker.

parents: KG–Grade 2: we recommend sitting with your student
Keep noise down nearby. The blender can wait until after class!
Teachers may remove students who disrupt class
